notes.title: Hotfix [0.5.2]
notes.content:
[h2]What we fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Handgun & Camera Zoom[/b] - Fixed a soft-lock triggered when using handguns with the camera fully zoomed out.
[*][b]Boomstrike & Backstab[/b] - Fixed line-of-sight issues with Ethereal Boomstrike V and corrected behavior of backstab mechanics.
[*][b]Dead Character VFX[/b] - Fixed some visual effects on dead characters for a cleaner view during combat.
[*][b]Korean Localization[/b] - Fixed the incorrect translation for “Hold” in the Korean version.
[*][b]Bug Reporting & UI[/b] - Fixed minor issues with the in-game bug reporting tool and some UI related elements.
[*][b]Quest Notifications[/b] - Fixed an issue where the quest notification background was too short (text was overflowing outside the background).
[*][b]Rebinding Popup[/b] - Fixed layout and visibility issues with the key rebinding popup.
[*][b]Push Softlock[/b] - Fixed a rare softlock that occurred when a push action was blocked by another animation.
[*][b]Bullet Sound[/b] - Disabled the incorrect audio from the Twin Barrels to prevent unintended sound effects.
[*][b]Crispy Pete[/b] - Fixed a soft-lock that could occur when an explosion happened near a dead character
[*][b]Rope Swing[/b] - Fixed a bug where rope swing wouldn’t work properly after Creepy Puppet kill (we were supposed to receive the Rope Swing ability).
[*][b]Camera Bug[/b] - Fixed a bug where the camera wouldn’t follow mouse movement after picking up an anomaly.
[/list][hr][/hr][h2]What we added:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Tooltip Improvements[/b] - Added and improved tooltips for “Undo” and “End Turn” buttons. Including an improved blinking effect to make the button more noticeable for players.
[*][b]Localization Update[/b] - General localization update across multiple languages.
[*][b]Speedup Button[/b] - Added a speedup button on the strategic map.
[*][b]Death Indicator[/b] - Added a new feature: defeated characters now have a cross on their portrait in the strategic map. Previously, they simply appeared with no HP.
[*][b]Localization UI[/b] - Added minor UI tweaks to improve localization display.
[*][b]Object Quality[/b] - Added a better performance on the lowest quality level.
[/list][hr][/hr][b]As always, thank you for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/]reports and feedback[/url]. 🙇[/b] Remember, if you spot anything weird after the hotfix, drop a note in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] or ping us on [url=https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb]Discord[/url]. ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310950/Nightmare_Frontier/

notes.title: Hotfix [0.5.1]
notes.content:
[h2]What we fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Node Highlighting Optimization[/b] - Fixed optimization to node highlighting on strategic map for a smoother experience in the later stages of the game.
[*][b]Ability Confirmation Glyph[/b] - Fixed the controller glyph for ability confirmation.
[*][b]Main Menu Navigation[/b] - Fixed navigation for the Quit Button.
[*][b]Rotten Barrel Push[/b] - Fixed a bug where pushing enemies into Rotten Barrels caused the game to freeze.
[*][b]Twin Barrels Sound[/b] - Fixed an issue where the sound of the Twin Barrels triggered additional unwanted sounds.
[*][b]Nightmare Essence[/b] - Fixed a bug where the ability to pick up Nightmare Essence wouldn't disappear after the turn ended and the Nightmare Essence was gone.
[*][b]Gunblade Charges[/b] - Fixed a bug with Gunblade charges not working correctly.
[*][b]Localization Fixes[/b] - Fixed various localization issues.
[*][b]Enemies Dissolve[/b] - Fixed the enemies dissolve feature (after death and undo of this effect).
[*][b]Bonus Movement[/b] - Fixed incorrect character movement after loading a saved game with a movement buff.
[*][b]Bug Report Tool[/b] - Fixed an error with the in‑game bug reporting tool.
[*][b]Ethereal Axegun[/b] - Fixed Axegun V so it now properly bypasses obstacles.
[*][b]Cactus & Coffin[/b] - Fixed a bug that allowed the player to walk into these two objects.
[*][b]Upgrade Panel[/b] - Fixed overlapping text in the Upgrade Panel.
[*][b]Stats Coloring[/b] - Fixed an issue with correct modified stats coloring.
[*][b]Run Summary[/b] - Fixed an issue where items didn’t fit on the screen after long runs by adding a scroll feature.
[*][b]Crispy Pete[/b] - Fixed a bug with Crispy Pete's death. Players can no longer target his corpse.
[*][b]Gunblade[/b] - Fixed a bug where attacking with the Level III Gunblade caused the game to freeze for a short period + Fixed a rare soft lock caused by using the Gunblade, then Undo, and using it again.
[*][b]Sorting[/b] - Fixed sorting issues for items and characters.
[/list][hr][/hr][h2]What we added:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Nightmare Essence Automatization[/b] - Added automatic collection for Nightmare Essence when entering its cell.
[*][b]Hit & Death Sounds[/b] - Added new sound effects for enemy hits and deaths.
[*][b]Common Item Drop[/b] - Reworked common item drops, providing more variety - especially in the Slums District.
[*][b]UI Improvements[/b] - Added general improvements to icons and text across the UI.
[*][b]Credits Update[/b] - Added the update to the Credits.
[/list][hr][/hr][b]As always, thank you for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/]reports and feedback[/url]. 🙇[/b] Remember, if you spot anything weird after the hotfix, drop a note in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] or ping us on [url=https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb]Discord[/url]. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Community Contest #1 🏆
notes.content:
[p]Hey!

We hope you’ve had a chance to get familiar with [b]Nightmare Frontier[/b], because we’ve prepared a [b]contest[/b]. To win, you’ll need both determination and experience but don’t worry - you’ll have the time to gain it!  

[b][u]PRIZES:[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p] [b]1st Place[/b]🥇 - Keys: 1x [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310950/Nightmare_Frontier/"]Nightmare Frontier (EA)[/url], 1x [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691190/Rogue_Waters/"]Rogue Waters[/url], 1x [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1282410/Hard_West_2/"]Hard West 2[/url] [🔑🔑🔑]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]2nd Place[/b]🥈 - Keys:: 1x [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310950/Nightmare_Frontier/"]Nightmare Frontier (EA)[/url], 1x [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691190/Rogue_Waters/"]Rogue Waters[/url] [🔑🔑]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]3rd Place[/b] 🥉 - Keys: 1x [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310950/Nightmare_Frontier/"]Nightmare Frontier (EA)[/url] [🔑]
[/p][/*][/list][p]As you’ve probably already noticed, the core gameplay in [b]Nightmare Frontier[/b] revolves around participating in raids. In the full version of the game, there will be five districts available. When starting an extraction, the player must choose one of them (in the demo, only one district - "The Slums" is available). After choosing a district, a path made up of nodes will appear. Completing one node allows you to choose the next destination, and so on... ⤵️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609500/95e997f19e6a0f8102f7674f4561c63ed003c200.png"][/img]
During a raid, you’ll fight enemies, collect loot, and receive buffs. All based on the decisions you make by choosing specific nodes. Depending on your combat performance and the choices you make, a [b]raid can end in one of three ways[/b]:
[/p][list][*][p] [b]Victory[/b] ✅ [i](you’ve reached "Safe Passage" & extracted)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Defeat[/b] ❌ [i](all your characters in raid have died)[/i]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Abandonment[/b] ❌ [i](you’ve left the raid)[/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p]To keep things challenging, [b]only raids that end in victory will count for this contest[/b]... ⤵️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609500/4d958dc8c5b10985e3f7ee6390f7ff4e638cac97.png"][/img]
Before we jump into the contest rules, make sure you’re able to take in-game screenshots directly through Steam. On the left, you can see where to [b]find the keyboard shortcut for taking screenshots[/b] [i](Steam>Settings>In Game>"Take a screenshot")[/i], and on the right, [b]where to locate your saved screenshots[/b] within the Steam app [i](Steam>View>"Recordings & Screenshots")[/i]... ⤵️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609500/a7ae8e0d5a7eefe6b71ce276991654e072a0a6d8.png"][/img]
Next & Last, to take part in the contest, you’ll also need to know [b]how to share screenshots on the Steam Community Hub[/b]. Select the screenshot you want to share, click “Share on Steam”, then add an appropriate description (for example: Nightmare Frontier, Community Contest #1) and hit "Upload". Don’t forget to set Visibility to "Public"... ⤵️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609500/31fe5ec89a62c90a99234c9085b7008dedd8ef04.png"][/img]
You’ve probably already guessed what the contest is about. ːsteamhappyː[/p][hr][/hr]
[h1]🏆 [u]The Longest Victorious Raid Contest[/u] 🏆[/h1][p]
[/p][h3][b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/b][/h3][p]As the name suggests, the [b]winner will be the one who ventures the deepest into a location[/b] and, most importantly - survives! Remember: the paths are randomized, so don’t give up too soon. You never know if your next run might just be the one that takes you the farthest! Next, [b]take a screenshot of the run summary screen[/b], that’s where we can see how far you made it. We’ll be looking at the [b]score on the left side[/b] (not the "Longest Raid"!), so make sure to [b]take screenshots right after each run[/b]... ⤵️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609500/905c6e0669d0940e441e64cd69a422fa4600bdb9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][u]HOW TO PARTICIPATE:[/u][/b][/h3][h3]Simply post a [b]link to your Steam screenshot[/b] on [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/0/600781012283191425/]Steam Thread[/url][/b]! [/h3][p][i](only screenshots uploaded on Steam & linked in this thread will be considered)[/i]

You have time until [b]Monday, June 16, 2025 (10 a.m. CEST)[/b] - that’s when we’ll pick the winners, so they can enjoy their Nightmare Frontier (EA) keys from the very first second of the launch!

In the meantime, we encourage you to join our [url="https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb"]Discord[/url] and keep us posted on your grinding progress...

Good luck! 🍀
[/p]

notes.title: DEMO: Patch Notes [0.4.3]
notes.content:
[h2]What we fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Overall Game Optimization[/b] - Fixed the FPS drops by various elements optimization.
[*][b]Nightmare Pressure Level[/b] - Fixed the balance of nightmare pressure. Now it will rise automatically after the end of every turn by 1. 
[*][b]Collectibles & Rewards[/b] - Fixed a bug where you wouldn’t receive item rewards after winning.
[*][b]Enemy Optimization[/b] - Fixed enemy behavior and performance in combat - fights should feel more responsive and challenging.
[*][b]Survivors Limitation[/b] - Fixed the issue of collecting more than 20 survivors during one expedition. [i](TBH we didn't thoguht that you'll be able to do it![/i] 😅[i])[/i]
[*][b]Enemies Behaviour[/b] - Fixed the enemies animations and VFX.
[*][b]Translucent Tooltip[/b] - Fixed the translucent status tooltip so it shows up correctly.
[*][b]Inventory Softlock[/b] - Fixed a rare issue where player could accidentally start a new run from inventory or event screen.
[*][b]SFX & Music[/b] - Fixed missing sound effects and the looped menu music. Now it works as intended.
[*][b]Quarters Update[/b] - Fixed visuals and labels in the Quarters panel, and added an interface that allows sorting characters.
[*][b]Map Scrolling[/b] - Fixed a bug where clicking outside a node sometimes selected it.
[*][b]UI & Tooltips[/b] - Fixed item tooltips so they now display properly on larger screen resolutions.
[*][b]Tutorial[/b] - Fixed a problem where pressing number keys during the tutorial could accidentally open unwanted panels.
[/list][hr][/hr][h2]What we added:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Character Customization[/b] - Added the rename option in your inventory. You could do this from the Quarters, but now you can also customize the names in the inventory.
[*][b]Ability & Item Balance[/b] - Added the next balance iteration of abilities and items.
[*][b]Items Comparison[/b] - Added the ability to compare items in your inventory.
[*][b]Reporting System[/b] - Added in-game bug reporting tool.
[*][b]HBAO Setting[/b] - Added the setting that allows you to turn off ambient occlusion - generates extra FPS.
[*][b]Grace Period[/b] - Added the protection period for beginners - ONCE after losing on Relaxing and Challenging difficulty, you keep your stuff.
[*][b]Enemies[/b] - Added new effects to the enemies - effect of disappearing as they die and appearing as they are summoned. 
[/list][hr][/hr][h2]Localization Notice (WIP)[/h2]
We added early version of localization, it's not completed yet. We will release update with full localization soon. If you spot any issues, we’d be super grateful if you let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/0/600781012283176895/]here[/url] on Steam.
[hr][/hr][b]As always, thank you for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/0/596276088808674334/]reports and feedback[/url]. 🙇[/b] Remember, if you spot anything weird after the patch, drop a note in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/0/596276088808674334/]thread[/url] or ping us on [url=https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb]Discord[/url]. BTW how's your [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] going? ːsteamhappyː

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609500/1fd9aa0a365b8820678e1b2219ba3aa59094411e.png"][/img]

We think that the game is really close (if not past) the [b]Official[/b] [[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f7e8.png"][/img]] [b]Playable[/b] status of SD verification. We've got a control scheme working. After the [b]Early Access[/b] launch, we'll work on the [b]Official Compatibility Rating[/b]. Meanwhile any feedback that's Deck-specific is more than welcome, either in [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/"]Community Forums[/url] or through our [url="https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb"]Discord[/url]. 🙇‍♂️

notes.title: DEMO: Patch Notes [0.4.2]
notes.content:
[h2]What we fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Antidotum / Whiskey / Bite of Beans[/b] - Fixed a soft-lock/error caused by using these items on enemies.
[*][b]Prologue Map Controls[/b] - Fixed an issue in the prologue that prevented scrolling to the top of the region.
[*][b]Shotgun Visual Effects[/b] - Fixed misaligned visual effects on the shotgun.
[*][b]Overcoming Tutorial[/b] - Fixed the overcoming tutorial trigger so now it appears.
[*][b]Win Jingle Replaced[/b] - Fixed the victory sound. Enjoy a fresh jingle for that post-battle dopamine hit.
[*][b]Dung Configuration[/b] - Fixed a bug where stepping into dung displayed “-1 armor” in green; now appears in red as intended.
[*][b]Enemy Spawns[/b] - Fixed spawns so enemies no longer all face the same direction.
[*][b]Safe Passage[/b] - Fixed safe passage spawn frequency by adding earlier exit nodes in the slums region to improve first area pacing.
[*][b]UI Clutter[/b] - Fixed an overlap between tutorial and dialogue in tactical mode.
[*][b]Balance[/b] - Fixed overall balance of the items. (Let us know how the new curve feels! ːsteamhappyː)
[/list][hr][/hr][b]As always, thank you for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/0/596276088808674334/]reports and feedback[/url]. 🙇[/b] If you spot anything weird after the patch, drop a note in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3310950/discussions/0/596276088808674334/]thread[/url] or ping us on [url=https://discord.gg/JzwhNQ5vWb]Discord[/url]. Stay safe out there... ⤵️
